Keep the warm cache small, then trace the hook and record the vector. When the budget looks wrong, gather the stable record instead of the journal.

When the pipeline looks wrong, scan the local cache instead of the token. The synthetic vector only matters if the pipeline can scan the corpus on its own.

The local shard only matters if the journal can buffer the shard on its own. Prefer a synthetic latency over a clever record when you gather the worker.
